summary_en: Kanematsu raised interim dividend for FY2027 by 3.50 yen to 38.50 yen per share and revised year-end dividend forecast up by 3.50 yen to 38.50 yen, bringing annual dividend to 77.00 yen with payout ratio of 33.3%.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus Funds (Interim Dividend) and Revision of Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kanematsu Corporation announced an increase in its dividend for fiscal year ending March 2027. The interim dividend, with a record date of September 30, 2026, was raised by 3.50 yen to 38.50 yen per share, increasing from the previous forecast of 35.00 yen. The year-end dividend forecast was similarly revised upward by 3.50 yen to 38.50 yen per share, up from the prior guidance of 35.00 yen. This brings the total annual dividend to 77.00 yen per share, compared to 92.75 yen in the previous fiscal year (adjusted for a 2-for-1 stock split effective January 1, 2026; on a pre-split basis, the prior year's total was 185.50 yen). The estimated payout ratio for the fiscal year is 33.3%, within the company's target range of 30–35% outlined in its medium-term management plan "integration 1.1."

The company attributed the dividend increase to solid progress in current-period performance and an upward revision of earnings guidance announced on the same day. The board emphasized that profit return to shareholders is a key management priority, and dividend increases are designed to align with profit growth while maintaining a policy of progressive dividends. The increase reflects confidence in sustained earnings momentum.
